exam_corrections_proposal_check.name: exam_corrections_proposal_check
exam_corrections_proposal_check.value: ("exam_corrections"."proposed_status" = 'scored' and "exam_corrections"."proposed_score" is not null and "exam_corrections"."proposed_score" between 0 and 100000) or ("exam_corrections"."proposed_status" in ('absent', 'exempt') and "exam_corrections"."proposed_score" is null)

exam_marks_score_check.name: exam_marks_score_check
exam_marks_score_check.value: ("exam_marks"."status" = 'scored' and "exam_marks"."score" is not null and "exam_marks"."score" between 0 and 100000) or ("exam_marks"."status" in ('unmarked', 'absent', 'exempt') and "exam_marks"."score" is null)

membership_role_assignments_scope_shape_.name: membership_role_assignments_scope_shape_check
membership_role_assignments_scope_shape_.value:
(scope_kind = 'tenant' and school_id is null and campus_id is null)
    or (scope_kind = 'school' and school_id is not null and campus_id is null)
    or (scope_kind = 'campus' and school_id is not null and campus_id is not null)

result_policies_bounds.name: result_policies_bounds
result_policies_bounds.value: "result_grading_policies"."revision" > 0 and "result_grading_policies"."overall_passing_percentage" between 0 and 10000 and jsonb_array_length("result_grading_policies"."bands") between 2 and 20
